_comment_channels: The BrainBit Flex has 4 user-placeable scalp electrodes plus a dedicated hardware reference and ground. Because the 4 electrodes can be placed at any site, this roster lists the positions the device SUPPORTS being placed at (the standard clinical 19-channel 10-20 set, same nomenclature as q21.json) rather than a fixed montage; `max_simultaneous_channels` (4) is the real hardware limit. A protocol may name any of these sites in `requires.channels`.
_comment_reference: The BrainBit's dedicated reference electrode is ear-mounted, and the SDK delivers data already referenced to it.
